name: Dim
author: sunny0826
description: DimAgent subscription usage in the Omarchy bar: the plan's credit ledger, when it resets, the allowances that ride along with it, and Dim's own local usage ledger by day and model.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: credits used and left, the reset countdown, the plan's feature allowances, and local usage by day, model, and cost — all read from the dim CLI and its own database.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the percentage next to the logo counts. Icon hides it entirely.

schema.label: Bar logo
schema.description: Mono: the Dim mark in the bar's own foreground colour, like every other bar icon. Color: the mark in its brand green. Logo: the full app icon.

schema.label: dim binary
schema.description: Optional. Only needed when the shell cannot find dim on its own PATH.
